exclusion_reason: No deterministic record or replay exists to step over.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the debugger reconstructs recorded state at any index and finds the first divergence identically in both harness.
expected_failing_assertion: No recorded run exists to step over.
active_gate_evidence: The report command keeps recording deterministic-replay-friendly and privacy-minimized.
procedure: Record a run with a planted divergence.
Reconstruct guest state at declared instruction index and compare with the run.
Reverse-step to the first differing instruction and compare across both harness.
pass_criterion: State reconstruction matches the run at every index.
First divergence is found identically in both harness.
